evidence: scripts/run_canonical_work_event_bootstrap.py accepts --task-id but explicitly rejects every task except STEGVERSE-CANONICAL-WORK-COORDINATION-001
scripts/install_and_run_canonical_work_event_bootstrap.py does not forward a task identity
